title: 🎈 Rohan hunts the letter B at breakfast... banana or apple? #kids #alphabet #phonics
title_alts: 🏀 Rohan learns the letter B sound from a ball, a bus, a butterfly #kids #alphabet
🍌 Rohan almost calls an apple a B word... here is the easy test #kids #phonics
description_hook: One letter, one sound, four everyday things. Say the B sound out loud with Rohan and then find it at your own table.

characters.name: Rohan
characters.description: four-year-old boy, short black hair, red striped t-shirt, small gap between his front teeth

scenes.narration: Today we learn one letter. It is the letter B.
scenes.caption: आज हम एक अक्षर सीखेंगे। यह अक्षर बी है।
scenes.image_brief: A cream card printed with a large capital B and a lowercase b, propped against a blue cereal bowl on a wooden breakfast table, warm morning light from a window.

scenes.narration: B says buh. Buh, buh, B. Capital B has two round bumps.
scenes.caption: बी बोलता है ब। ब, ब, बी। बड़ी बी में दो गोल उभार हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Close view of a single wooden capital letter B block standing on a pale kitchen counter, its two round bumps facing the viewer, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Here is a ball. Ball starts with buh. B for ball.
scenes.caption: यह एक गेंद है। बॉल शब्द ब से शुरू होता है। बी से बॉल।
scenes.image_brief: A red rubber ball sitting beside a wooden capital letter B block on a wooden breakfast table, plain cream wall behind, warm morning light.

scenes.narration: Your turn. Say buh, buh, ball out loud with me.
scenes.caption: अब तुम्हारी बारी। मेरे साथ जोर से बोलो: ब, ब, बॉल।
scenes.image_brief: An open picture book lying flat on the kitchen table showing one huge letter B with a red ball drawn beside it, bright morning light across the page.

scenes.narration: Buh, buh, B like ball. That is our B sound.
scenes.caption: ब, ब, बी जैसे बॉल। यही हमारी बी की आवाज़ है।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden capital letter B block and a red rubber ball side by side on a kitchen table, sunlight falling across both, cheerful and calm.

scenes.narration: Now look outside. A big bus rolls past. Buh, buh, bus.
scenes.caption: अब बाहर देखो। एक बड़ी बस निकल रही है। ब, ब, बस।
scenes.image_brief: A yellow school bus rolling along a quiet street seen through a kitchen window, a wooden capital letter B block on the windowsill in the foreground, morning light.

scenes.narration: A butterfly lands on the window. Butterfly begins with B too.
scenes.caption: खिड़की पर एक तितली बैठी है। बटरफ़्लाई भी बी से शुरू होता है।
scenes.image_brief: An orange butterfly resting on the outside of a kitchen window pane, a wooden capital letter B block on the sill just inside, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Count three B words: ball, bus, butterfly. All say buh first.
scenes.caption: तीन बी शब्द गिनो: बॉल, बस, बटरफ़्लाई। सब में पहले ब है।
scenes.image_brief: Three objects lined up on a kitchen table, a red ball, a yellow toy bus and a paper butterfly, with a wooden capital letter B block in front of them, bright light.

scenes.narration: Which one starts with B, a banana or an apple? Banana.
scenes.caption: बी से कौन शुरू होता है, बनाना या सेब? बनाना।
scenes.image_brief: A yellow banana and a green apple side by side on a white plate on a kitchen table, a wooden capital letter B block beside the banana, clear daylight.

scenes.narration: We found ball, bus, butterfly and banana. Buh, buh, B like ball.
scenes.caption: हमने बॉल, बस, बटरफ़्लाई और बनाना देखे। ब, ब, बी जैसे बॉल।
scenes.image_brief: A red ball, a yellow toy bus, a paper butterfly and a banana arranged in a row on a kitchen table around a wooden capital letter B block, warm afternoon light.

title: 🌙 Kavya looks for the letter M at bedtime... milk or juice? #kids #alphabet #letterm
title_alts: ⭐ Kavya learns the letter M sound from the moon and a mango #kids #alphabet
🐒 Kavya nearly misses the M in monkey... here is the quick fix #kids #phonics
description_hook: The letter M hides in the sky, in a fruit bowl and in a glass of milk. Say the mmm sound with Kavya before lights out.

characters.name: Kavya
characters.description: five-year-old girl, long black plaited hair, yellow pyjamas with a star print, always holding a small cloth rabbit

scenes.narration: Tonight we learn one letter. It is the letter M, big and small.
scenes.caption: आज रात हम एक अक्षर सीखेंगे। यह अक्षर एम है, बड़ा और छोटा।
scenes.image_brief: A round paper card printed with a large capital M and a lowercase m resting on a bedroom windowsill at night, dark blue sky and stars outside.

scenes.narration: M says mmm. Mmm, mmm, M. Capital M has two pointy hills.
scenes.caption: एम बोलता है म। म, म, एम। बड़ी एम में दो नुकीली पहाड़ियाँ हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Close view of a wooden capital letter M block on a bedside table, its two pointed peaks clear, soft lamplight and a dark window behind it.

scenes.narration: Look up at the moon. Moon starts with mmm. M for moon.
scenes.caption: ऊपर चाँद देखो। मून शब्द म से शुरू होता है। एम से मून।
scenes.image_brief: A full white moon high in a deep blue night sky above rooftops, seen through an open bedroom window, a wooden capital letter M block on the sill.

scenes.narration: Your turn. Say mmm, mmm, moon with me, nice and slow.
scenes.caption: अब तुम्हारी बारी। मेरे साथ धीरे से बोलो: म, म, मून।
scenes.image_brief: An open bedtime picture book lying on a quilt showing one huge letter M with a small moon drawn beside it, warm lamplight.

scenes.narration: Mmm, mmm, M for moon. You found the M sound.
scenes.caption: म, म, एम जैसे मून। तुमने एम की आवाज़ पकड़ ली।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden capital letter M block on a windowsill with the bright full moon framed behind it in the night sky, calm and quiet.

scenes.narration: Now think about food. A sweet mango begins with mmm too.
scenes.caption: अब खाने की बात। मीठा मैंगो भी म से शुरू होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A ripe yellow mango on a small plate beside a wooden capital letter M block on a bedside table, warm lamplight, dark window behind.

scenes.narration: A monkey swings on a branch. Monkey starts with M as well.
scenes.caption: एक बंदर डाल पर झूल रहा है। मंकी भी एम से शुरू होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A brown monkey sitting on a thick tree branch in a leafy zoo enclosure in daylight, a wooden capital letter M block on the low wall in the foreground.

scenes.narration: Which starts with M, milk or juice? Milk. Mmm, mmm, milk.
scenes.caption: एम से कौन शुरू होता है, मिल्क या जूस? मिल्क। म, म, मिल्क।
scenes.image_brief: A glass of milk and a glass of orange juice side by side on a kitchen counter at night, a wooden capital letter M block next to the milk, soft light.

scenes.narration: Moon, mango, monkey, milk. Four M words. Mmm, mmm, M for moon.
scenes.caption: मून, मैंगो, मंकी, मिल्क। चार एम शब्द। म, म, एम जैसे मून।
scenes.image_brief: Four things in a row on a windowsill at night, a small round moon lamp, a mango, a toy monkey and a glass of milk, with a wooden capital letter M block in front, gentle light.
